title: Signed online update source
description: Download update metadata and its signed statement from an allowed HTTPS host, verify the detached Ed25519 signature, package size and SHA-256, and place the artifact in private staging. The web application never overwrites code or runs migrations.
no_staged_packages: No verified update package is currently staged.
stage_success: The update package passed signature, size and SHA-256 verification and was placed in private staging.
stage_boundary: Staging is not installation. Backups, a maintenance window, PHP preflight, migrations, health checks and rollback approval are still required.
prepare_success: The signed package was extracted into a private candidate directory and passed the release manifest, migration and PHP syntax checks. Nothing was installed.
